parameters.prompt: The exact snake-tailed demon lady in the reference casts ONE ground curse in place. From the resting pose she raises both hands up to her chest with the palms together, then thrusts both open palms down and forward toward the ground in front of her, the upper body bending forward over the coiled tail, holds this pressing pose for a moment, then straightens and calmly returns to the exact original pose and holds it. The tail stays coiled and does not slither or move across the ground. She stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and one snake tail. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character, the tail tip and the hair stay inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, face, hair, headdress, clothing and scaled tail. No slithering, turning, jumping, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, magic effects, smoke, mist, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: gather the hands over the first second and a half, thrust down around two seconds and hold to three seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
